answer: Got it — I've saved this as a standing convention: library crates use `thiserror`, binaries use `anyhow`, never reversed. I'll apply it in future Rust work on this codebase.

memories.content: In this codebase, library crates must use thiserror for their error types, and binaries must use anyhow for theirs; the reverse pairing (anyhow in libraries or thiserror in binaries) is disallowed.
